city.malaga.name: Malaga
city.malaga.intro: All of Malaga, block by block: from the airport and the Guadalhorce to El Palo, up to the ring road. The old town and Calle Larios, the Cathedral, the Alcazaba and Gibralfaro, the port, the beaches from La Misericordia to El Palo, Teatinos, La Rosaleda and some 135,000 buildings. Streets, squares, parks and every building's outline and height come from the map; one block is one metre.

guide.city.title: Malaga city guide
guide.city.card: Welcome to Malaga! See what you can do in the city.
guide.city.intro: Malaga as it really is: its streets, landmarks, buses and shops, block by block (1 block is 1 metre). Here is what you can do:
guide.city.move.text: Walk, or ride the real EMT city buses (blue stop signs, a ticket is 2 coins). The world map (M) takes you anywhere at once: free in creative, one life in survival. The minimap shows where you are.
guide.city.money.text: Coins in hand and in the bank (for signed-in players). Cash machines pay out and take in coins; the counter of the Banco de España by the Paseo del Parque has the exchange (sell what you gather, gems, gold), deposits and the central bank. A salary comes every Soulcraft month.
guide.city.food.text: Market stalls sell ingredients; cook them at a workbench: espetos, gazpacho, paella, churros. Restaurants, cafes and bars serve meals on the spot, dearer but more filling.
guide.city.missions.text: Five city missions: the tourist route, a bus ride to the beach, a paella, the restaurant critic and first savings. Each pays crystals and coins; the gold arrow on the screen leads the way, and the ? button by each mission explains it.
guide.city.heist.text: The big mission: twelve informants each give a piece of the bank's plan. Put the puzzle together, take the Gran Diamante from the vault unseen, trade it at the counter and become the mayor of Malaga.
guide.city.gems.text: Hidden gem caches lie in parks, squares and beaches (each opens once). A gold pan used in water finds gold nuggets. Gems sell at the exchange, the rarer the dearer.
guide.city.farm.text: Plant crops and orange bushes, keep chickens with nest boxes and incubators, and sell what you grow at the exchange.
guide.city.friends.text: Open your world to friends: the missions and the big heist count for the whole team.
guide.m.deposit:
Cash machines stand by Malaga's real banks; the minimap and the world map (M) help to find one. The counter of the Banco de España by the Paseo del Parque works too.
Use the machine (F, or the cube button) and choose Deposit: any amount counts.
Coins come from missions, from selling at the exchange and from the monthly salary. You need to be signed in: the wallet lives on the server.
guide.m.tour:
Follow the gold arrow on the screen and the marker on the minimap: they always point to the next landmark.
A landmark ticks off when you come within about 30 blocks of it.
Walk, ride a bus (blue stop signs) or jump there with the world map (M); in survival a jump costs a life.
guide.m.bus:
Find a blue stop sign: using it shows the next buses and the lines on the map, and sells tickets (2 coins, or 13 for ten rides). Pick a line that goes along the Paseo del Parque towards La Malagueta.
When the bus stops its doors open: step in and validate your ticket at the yellow validator (F), or buy one from the driver. Without one, the inspector puts you out.
Stay on for two stops, then press STOP (X) to get off at the next stop near La Malagueta. Getting off anywhere else starts this mission over.
guide.m.paella:
Market stalls (food shops all over the city, and the Mercado de Atarazanas) sell rice, sardines, tomatoes, olive oil and charcoal.
A paella needs rice, a sardine, tomatoes, olive oil and charcoal (the fire), cooked at a workbench: place one (it is made from planks) and open it.
Then walk to La Malagueta beach and eat the paella there.
guide.m.critic:
Malaga has more than a thousand restaurants, cafes and bars: use one (F) to see its menu.
Order and eat a dish in three different places; the same place twice does not count.
A meal costs coins, but fills you up more than cooking yourself.
guide.m.task:
Each informant waits at a place in the city with a gold ! over the head; follow this task and the arrow on the screen shows the way.
Some ask for something first: an item to bring, a bus ride, a meal, gold from the water, a hidden gem cache.
Each task done gives one piece of the bank's plan; with all twelve, put the plan together in Missions > Plan.
guide.m.final:
Open the plan (the map item, or Missions > Plan): the weak spot in the vault's back wall (red cross), the guards' rounds (red dashes), the old sewer (brown dots), the coded vault door and the Gran Diamante.
The quiet way: round the back of the Banco de España, break the weak wall with a stone pickaxe or better. The other ways have their own informants in the missions (marked with a gear): the guard's uniform, the sewer key, firecrackers and the vault door's code (at night only one guard is on duty).
With friends: one of you dances, waves or cheers in the bank's hall (G) and the guards watch the show while the others go in.
The guards see about 11 blocks ahead in a wide cone, not through walls. Behind the counter, in the vault or with the diamond, a guard who sees you raises the alarm and shoots: 2.5 hearts a shot (armor helps).
Take the diamond (use it), then get at least 60 blocks from the bank. If you die on the way, the guards take it back. Then trade it at the counter: the biggest sum in the game, and Malaga makes you its mayor.
test.title: Superadmin test panel
test.info: Only for your own test account: everything needed to try every feature at once.
help.v.d.guide: the guide on the card, or the Malaga missions
heist.ap.uniform.desc: A tailor on Calle Larios has a guard's uniform in your size.
heist.ap.sewer.desc: A sewer worker knows the old tunnel under the bank and has the key to its hatches.
heist.ap.fireworks.desc: At Muelle Uno a man who makes fireworks for the fair sells a few firecrackers, no questions asked.
heist.ap.code.desc: The bank's night watchman eats at the Mercado de Atarazanas. Have a meal with him and he forgets a note with the vault's code.
heist.notHere: Only near the Banco de España in Malaga.
heist.tooFar: Too far from the bank: the guards would not hear it.
heist.uniformOn: You look like a guard: the guards do not notice you for {s} s (unless very close).
heist.uniformOff: The uniform no longer fools anyone.
heist.distracted: Bang! The guards run to the door ({s} s).
heist.guardsBack: The guards go back to their rounds.
heist.grateLocked: A locked hatch. The sewer worker has the key.
heist.grateDown: You climb down into the old sewer.
heist.grateUp: You climb up through the hatch.
heist.doorLocked: The vault door is locked. The night watchman knows the code.
heist.doorOpen: Code accepted: the vault door is open for {s} s.
test.tools: All tools for the other ways
test.toolsDone: Uniform, sewer key, firecrackers and the vault code are in your bag.
guide.m.ap_uniform:
Meet the tailor on Calle Larios: the uniform goes into your bag.
Use it (F, or the cube button) near the bank: for 45 seconds the guards take you for one of them. Only a guard right next to you sees through it.
Put it on just before going behind the counter or into the vault, and be quick: it works once.
guide.m.ap_sewer:
Meet the sewer worker by the Paseo del Parque: he gives you the key to the hatches.
In a corner of the bank's hall, by the side wall, there is a sewer hatch (a dark iron cover in the floor; the plan shows the tunnel as a brown dotted line).
Use the hatch to climb down, walk along the tunnel under the counter, and use the hatch above you at its end: you come up inside the vault. The same way back.
guide.m.ap_fireworks:
Meet the pyrotechnician at Muelle Uno: three firecrackers.
Use one outside, within about 80 blocks of the bank: for 25 seconds all the guards run to the front door and look out at the street.
That is your moment: in through the weak wall, the sewer or the vault door, take the diamond and get out. Friends in your world hear it too.
guide.m.ap_code:
Find the night watchman at the Mercado de Atarazanas, then eat a meal at any restaurant: he leaves you the note with the code.
With the code, use the vault door (the steel door behind the counter): it opens for 40 seconds, then closes again.
At night only one guard is on duty, in the vault, and he sees less far: the best time for the front way.
fab.m.maestro.desc: A man who signs his letters 'El Maestro' waits in a farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín. He has a plan.
fab.m.class.desc: Five lessons at the blackboard, a quiz, and then your alias.
fab.m.monos.desc: A seamstress near the Plaza de la Merced has sewn five red jumpsuits.
fab.m.mascaras.desc: A carnival maker by the Cathedral has the white masks with the painted grin.
fab.m.camion.desc: A driver at María Zambrano station lends a truck that looks just like the mint's own.
fab.m.planos.desc: An engineering student at Teatinos has the factory's old blueprints, the tunnel included.
fab.m.entrada.desc: Go to the Tabacalera and in through the front door. The crew follows.
fab.m.asedio.desc: Print ten pallets of money while the police wait outside: the presses, the red phone, the doors, the workers.
fab.m.tunel.desc: Open the hatch in the pallet room, dig through the soft earth under the floor and come out across the street.
fab.m.huida.desc: Bring the bags to the farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín.
fab.s.fab_enter: Go in through La Fábrica's front door
fab.s.fab_out: Dig the tunnel and get out
fab.readyEntry: Everything is ready. To La Fábrica!
fab.say.tunnelNow: El Maestro on the radio: "Ten pallets. Open the hatch in the pallet room and dig."
fab.say.inside: We are in. Doors shut. Workers to the canteen, nobody gets hurt. Start the presses!
fab.say.dig: Dig through the soft earth to the hatch at the end.
fab.doorShut: A steel door, shut. Not yet.
fab.needSupplies: A press needs a paper roll and a can of ink (the stacks and barrels along the side wall).
fab.out: Out across the street with {n} bags. To El Maestro!
fab.raidHeld: Door held! The police pull back.
fab.phoneBad: The negotiator hangs up angry (-{n} patience).
fab.caught: You talk the worker back to the canteen.
fab.raidLost: The police got in for a moment: {n} pallets lost.
fab.raid.front: Police at the front door! Hold it.
fab.raid.back: Police at the back door! Hold it.
fab.escaping: A worker is slipping out of the canteen! Catch up with him.
fab.stormed: The police lost patience and stormed in. The crew got away, the money did not. Try again.
fab.hud.title: La Fábrica: the siege
fab.class.title: El Maestro's class
fab.class.question: Question {n} of {total}
fab.class.failed: {n} of {total}: not yet. Again, from the first lesson.
fab.class.alias: Choose your alias. From now on, no real names.
fab.lesson.1.title: The place
fab.lesson.1: The old tobacco factory, La Tabacalera, is now the city's mint. We go in through the front door with the truck, and nobody leaves until the job is done.
fab.lesson.2.title: The rules
fab.lesson.2: Nobody gets hurt. The workers wait in the canteen and we treat them well. We print our own money: we steal from nobody.
fab.lesson.3.title: The presses
fab.lesson.3: Each press needs a paper roll and a can of ink: the stacks and barrels are along the side wall. A jammed press stops: fix it at once. Ten pallets and we are done.
fab.lesson.4.title: The police
fab.lesson.4: The negotiator will call on the red phone. Answer, stay calm, keep her patient. When the police try a door, hold it. And if a worker slips away, bring him back gently.
fab.lesson.5.title: The way out
fab.lesson.5: When the pallets are ready, open the hatch in the pallet room and dig the tunnel under the floor. It comes out across the street. Then bring the bags to me.
fab.q.3: Who calls on the red phone?
fab.q.4: How many pallets do we print?
fab.q.5.a2: Through the tunnel under the floor
fab.neg.title: The red phone
fab.neg.line0: This is Inspector Ruiz. Nobody needs to get hurt. What do you want?
fab.neg.line1: Let me speak to the workers. I need to know they are fine.
fab.neg.line2: You cannot stay in there forever. Come out now and it will go easier.
fab.neg.line3: We have closed the whole street. Tell me your name.
fab.neg.line4: The workers' families are here. Give me something to tell them.
fab.neg.c0: Everyone inside is safe and calm. Nobody will be hurt.
fab.neg.c1: We need more time. Call back later.
fab.neg.c2: We do not talk to the police!
fab.neg.c3: Send food for the workers, they are hungry.
fab.neg.hint: Calm answers keep the police patient; a rude one brings them sooner. Stalling delays the next raid.
fab.end.title: Season 1: the end
fab.end.text: El Maestro opens the farmhouse door and smiles. "Well done, {alias}. Nobody hurt, and the money is ours."
fab.end.guest: Sign in to have the bags paid in coins.
fab.end.items: New in the wardrobe: the red jumpsuit and the grinning mask.
fab.end.next: Season 2 is here: El Maestro will call you (see the missions).
guide.m.fab_maestro:
Follow the gold arrow to the farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín: El Maestro has a gold ! over his head.
When you meet him, his class opens on its own.
guide.m.fab_class:
Read the five lessons: the quiz asks about them. Four of five right answers pass.
If the class closed, go back to El Maestro and use him... or open this mission's guide and come back later: the class reopens when you meet him again.
guide.m.fab_entrada:
La Tabacalera is west of the centre, by the Avenida de Sor Teresa Prat (the world map helps).
Use the steel front door: the crew and you are inside, and the siege begins.
guide.m.fab_asedio:
Take paper rolls and ink cans from the stacks and barrels along the side wall, then use an idle press: it prints a pallet in about half a minute. The crew restarts an idle press now and then.
The panel on the left shows what needs doing: answer the red phone in the lobby (calm answers keep the police patient), hold the door the police try (use it), fix a jammed press, catch a worker slipping out.
If the police run out of patience they storm in and the siege starts over.
guide.m.fab_tunel:
In the pallet room at the back, a hatch in the floor by the wall opens now: use it to climb down.
Break the soft earth along the tunnel (any tool, even your hand) to the hatch at the end, and use it from below: you come out across the street with the bags.
guide.m.fab_huida: Follow the arrow back to the farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín with the bags. The season ends there.
guide.m.fab_monos:
Four contacts wait around the city, each with a gold ! over the head. Follow each mission and the arrow shows the way.
Any order. When all four are done, La Fábrica opens.
guide.m.fab_mascaras:
Four contacts wait around the city, each with a gold ! over the head. Follow each mission and the arrow shows the way.
Any order. When all four are done, La Fábrica opens.
guide.m.fab_camion:
Four contacts wait around the city, each with a gold ! over the head. Follow each mission and the arrow shows the way.
Any order. When all four are done, La Fábrica opens.
guide.m.fab_planos:
Four contacts wait around the city, each with a gold ! over the head. Follow each mission and the arrow shows the way.
Any order. When all four are done, La Fábrica opens.
guide.city.fabrica.text: A heist in the style of the famous series: El Maestro teaches the plan, the crew takes over the old tobacco factory and prints money under siege. Nobody is hurt. Starts in the missions. Season 2, the gold of La Térmica, opens after season 1. Season 3, El Maestro's rescue at the port, opens after season 2.
fab.m.llamada.desc: El Maestro has news about Siroco. Go to his farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín.
fab.m.clase2.desc: El Maestro's plan: Siroco's rescue and the gold of La Térmica. Learn it and pass the quiz.
fab.m.orden.desc: A forger at the Mercado de Atarazanas has a transfer order with all the right stamps.
fab.m.uniforme.desc: A tailor in Calle Larios has a police uniform in your size.
fab.m.lancha.desc: A fisherman at La Malagueta keeps a boat ready for the day of the rescue.
fab.m.rescate.desc: At Muelle Uno the police wait with Siroco. Show the order and keep your story straight.
fab.m.buzos.desc: In Pedregalejo a diver lends the crew suits for the flooded vault.
fab.m.fundidor.desc: In El Palo an old goldsmith shows how to melt bars into grains.
fab.m.turnos.desc: From Gibralfaro, watch the guards of La Térmica change shifts.
fab.m.entrada2.desc: The crew goes in through the front door of La Térmica. The guards are asked to wait calmly.
fab.m.oro.desc: Melt twelve gold bars in the furnaces, under siege.
fab.m.desague.desc: Out through the outflow grate in the vault's floor, with the gold.
fab.m.mar.desc: Bring the gold to El Maestro's boat on La Misericordia beach.
fab.s.oro_free: Answer the officer's questions on the quay
fab.s.oro_enter: Go in through the door of La Térmica
fab.s.oro_out: Go out through the outflow grate in the vault
guide.m.fab_llamada:
Follow the gold arrow to the farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín: El Maestro has a gold ! over his head.
When you meet him, the second class opens on its own.
guide.m.fab_clase2:
Read the five lessons: the questions are about them, and so are the officer's at the quay.
Four right answers out of five pass; otherwise the class starts again.
guide.m.fab_orden:
Go to the Mercado de Atarazanas: the forger has a gold ! over the head.
The forged order goes into your inventory: keep it for Muelle Uno.
guide.m.fab_uniforme:
Go to Calle Larios: the tailor has a gold ! over the head.
The uniform goes into your inventory: keep it for Muelle Uno.
guide.m.fab_lancha: Go to La Malagueta beach: the fisherman has a gold ! over the head.
guide.m.fab_rescate:
Go to Muelle Uno with the order and the uniform: an officer stands there with Siroco.
The officer's questions open on their own: who signed the order, its number, where the prisoner goes (lesson 2).
Two right answers out of three and Siroco is free; otherwise come back a little later.
guide.m.fab_buzos: Go to Pedregalejo beach: the diver has a gold ! over the head.
guide.m.fab_fundidor: Go to El Palo: the goldsmith has a gold ! over the head.
guide.m.fab_turnos: Climb to Gibralfaro: the lookout has a gold ! over the head.
guide.m.fab_entrada2:
Follow the arrow to La Térmica, the white building near La Misericordia.
Use the front door: the whole crew goes in (friends in your world too).
guide.m.fab_oro:
Take gold bars from the shelves in the vault at the back (two at a time) and use a furnace in the hall: it melts a bar in about 20 seconds while there is power.
The panel on the left shows the water: keep both pumps by the vault's wall running (use a stopped one). If the vault floods, no bars for 30 seconds.
When the police cut the power, use the generator in the lobby. When they drill a wall, use the glowing spot to brace it. Answer the red phone calmly.
If the police run out of patience they storm in and the siege starts over.
guide.m.fab_desague:
The outflow grate is in the floor at the back of the vault: use it.
You come out behind the building with the sacks of gold.
guide.m.fab_mar: Follow the arrow to La Misericordia beach: El Maestro waits there with the boat.
oro.readyRescue: Everything is ready: to Muelle Uno, for Siroco!
oro.readyEntry: Diving suits, the furnace man, the guards' shifts: to La Térmica!
oro.say.pipeNow: El Maestro: twelve bars! The outflow grate in the vault's floor is open: out through the pipe.
oro.say.freed: Siroco is free! The crew is whole again.
oro.say.inside: We're in! The guards wait calmly in the lobby. Bars from the vault into the furnaces.
oro.doorShut: The door of La Térmica is shut. Its time will come.
oro.doorLocked: The door stays shut: the police are outside.
oro.notNow: Not now: only during the siege of La Térmica.
oro.flooded: The vault is flooded! Wait until the pumps drain it.
oro.handsFull: Your hands are full: two bars at a time.
oro.gotBar: A gold bar. Into a furnace with it!
oro.needBar: Bring a gold bar from the shelves in the vault.
oro.grateShut: The outflow grate opens when the twelve bars are melted.
oro.out: Out through the pipe, behind the building, with {n} sacks of gold!
oro.powerBack: The generator roars: the power is back.
oro.pumpStopped: Pump {n} has stopped! The water is rising.
oro.flood: The vault flooded! No bars for 30 seconds.
oro.powerCut: The police cut the power! The furnaces and pumps stop: start the generator in the lobby.
oro.drillThrough: The police drilled through the wall and lose patience.
oro.drill.left: The police are drilling the left wall! Brace it.
oro.drill.right: The police are drilling the right wall! Brace it.
oro.stormed: The police lost patience and stormed in. The crew got away, the gold did not. Try again.
oro.hud.title: La Fábrica 2: the gold
oro.class.title: El Maestro's class: the gold
oro.class.ready: Siroco first, then the gold. The crew is waiting for you.
oro.lesson.1.title: Siroco
oro.lesson.1: After the factory, Siroco was caught. Tomorrow the police move him by boat from Muelle Uno. We get him back without a single blow: with a story the officer believes.
oro.lesson.2.title: The story
oro.lesson.2: You are a transfer officer. The order is signed by Judge Ortega, its number is 4-7-1, and the prisoner goes to Sevilla. Learn it by heart: the officer on the quay will ask.
oro.lesson.3.title: La Térmica
oro.lesson.3: Under the old Térmica building by the sea lies the state's hidden gold. When the vault opens, the sea seeps in: two pumps keep the water out. Keep them running.
oro.lesson.4.title: The furnaces
oro.lesson.4: Bars from the vault's shelves go into the furnaces, and the molten gold runs down a pipe as grains. Twelve bars. The police will cut the power: start the generator again. They will drill a wall: brace it.
oro.lesson.5.title: The way out
oro.lesson.5: With the gold melted, the outflow grate in the vault's floor opens: the pipe leads out behind the building. Then to La Misericordia beach, where I wait with a boat.
oro.q.2: What keeps the water out of the vault?
oro.q.3: What do the police cut to stop the furnaces?
oro.q.4: How many bars do we melt?
oro.q.5: Where does El Maestro wait at the end?
oro.rescue.title: The officer on the quay
oro.rescue.need: You need the forged transfer order and the police uniform: the contacts at the Mercado de Atarazanas and in Calle Larios have them.
oro.rescue.intro: The officer guarding Siroco looks at your uniform and at the order in your hand.
oro.rescue.yes: All in order. He is yours, officer. Have a good trip to Sevilla.
oro.rescue.no: Something does not add up. Come back when your papers are straight.
oro.neg.title: The red phone: Inspector Vega
oro.neg.line0: This is Inspector Vega. I know about the gold. Nobody needs to get hurt.
oro.neg.line1: The guards' families are worried. Are they all right?
oro.neg.line2: We can stop your pumps too, you know. Give me something.
oro.neg.line3: Talk to me, and I will hold back the drills for a while.
oro.neg.line4: You have until dawn. Then we come in.
oro.neg.c0: The guards are safe and calm in the lobby. Nobody gets hurt.
oro.neg.c1: We need more time. Call back later.
oro.neg.c3: Send water and food for the guards.
oro.neg.hint: Calm answers keep the police patient; stalling holds back the next drill and power cut; a rude one brings them sooner.
oro.end.title: Season 2: the end
oro.end.text: El Maestro helps you onto the boat. "Siroco is free, the gold is ours, and nobody was hurt. Well done, {alias}."
oro.end.guest: Sign in to have the gold paid in coins.
oro.end.items: New in the wardrobe: the diving suit and the golden mask.
oro.end.next: Season 3 is here: Siroco has news (see the missions).
fab.m.aviso.desc: Siroco calls the crew to the farmhouse: something has happened to El Maestro.
fab.m.plan3.desc: Siroco explains how to get El Maestro out. Learn it and pass the quiz.
fab.m.hacker.desc: At La Rosaleda a hacker explains the warehouse's fuse box.
fab.m.cerrajero.desc: In Huelin an old locksmith lends you his stethoscope for the safe.
fab.m.barquero.desc: At Muelle Uno a boatman agrees to wait at the Muelle de Heredia.
fab.m.entrada3.desc: Go in through the door of the old port warehouse.
fab.m.sigilo.desc: Cross the hall unseen by the cameras, and the corridor between the laser beams.
fab.m.caja.desc: Open the office safe with the stethoscope: the key to the cell is inside.
fab.m.celda.desc: Open El Maestro's cell with the key.
fab.m.fuga.desc: Run with El Maestro to the boat at the Muelle de Heredia before the police block the port.
fab.s.puerto_enter: Go in through the warehouse's door
guide.m.fab_aviso:
Follow the gold arrow to the farmhouse above Ciudad Jardín: Siroco has a gold ! over the head.
When you meet him, his plan opens on its own.
guide.m.fab_plan3:
Read the five lessons: the cameras, the lasers, the safe and the run.
Four right answers out of five pass; otherwise the plan starts again.
guide.m.fab_hacker:
Go to La Rosaleda: the hacker has a gold ! over the head.
After this, the fuse box in the warehouse can blind the cameras.
guide.m.fab_cerrajero:
Go to Huelin: the locksmith has a gold ! over the head.
The stethoscope goes into your inventory: keep it for the safe.
guide.m.fab_barquero: Go to Muelle Uno: the boatman has a gold ! over the head.
guide.m.fab_entrada3:
Follow the arrow to the old port warehouse near the Plaza de la Marina.
Use its front door: the whole crew goes in (friends in your world too).
guide.m.fab_sigilo:
Two cameras sweep the hall: their red cones show where they look. Hide behind a crate, or wait until a cone has passed.
The fuse box by the door (use it) switches the cameras off for 25 seconds; then it needs a minute.
In the corridor, cross each laser beam while it is out. Seen, or touching a beam: the alarm, and the crew slips out to try again.
guide.m.fab_caja:
The safe is in the office, on the left at the back: use it.
Turn the dial with the arrows and listen: a click is the right number, a faint click means it is close. Set three numbers.
The key to the cell goes into your inventory.
guide.m.fab_celda: The cell is behind bars, on the right at the back: use its door with the key.
guide.m.fab_fuga:
The alarm sounds: run with El Maestro to the boat at the Muelle de Heredia (follow the arrow).
The panel on the left counts down; if time runs out, the police block the port and you start again from the warehouse.
puerto.ready: Everything is ready: to the port warehouse!
puerto.say.office: Past the cameras and the lasers! The office safe is on the left.
puerto.say.run: El Maestro is free! The alarm is ringing: to the boat at the Muelle de Heredia!
puerto.say.inside: We're in. Quiet now: the cameras are watching the hall.
puerto.say.freed: El Maestro: "I knew you would come."
puerto.doorShut: The warehouse door is shut. Its time will come.
puerto.toBoat: No time: to the boat at the Muelle de Heredia!
puerto.camsAlreadyOff: The cameras are already off ({s} s).
puerto.fuseWait: The fuse box is still warm: wait {s} s.
puerto.cellLocked: The cell is locked: the key is in the safe.
puerto.needKey: You need the key from the safe.
puerto.blocked: The police blocked the port! The crew slips back to the warehouse: try again.
puerto.spotted: Spotted! The crew slips out of the warehouse: try again.
puerto.camsOff: Fuse pulled: the cameras are off for {s} seconds.
puerto.hud.title: La Fábrica 3: El Maestro
puerto.hud.camsOn: Cameras on: stay out of the red cones
puerto.hud.boat: The boat waits at the Muelle de Heredia
puerto.class.title: Siroco's plan: El Maestro
puerto.class.ready: Quiet in, quick out. Let's bring him home.
puerto.lesson.1.title: El Maestro
puerto.lesson.1: On the beach, Inspector Vega caught El Maestro. He is held in the old port warehouse until his transfer. This time we get him out quietly.
puerto.lesson.2.title: The cameras
puerto.lesson.2: Two cameras sweep the hall of crates. Stay out of their red cones or hide behind a crate. The fuse box by the door blinds them for 25 seconds, then needs a minute.
puerto.lesson.3.title: The lasers
puerto.lesson.3: Two red beams cross the corridor, on and off every few seconds. Wait until a beam goes out, then cross. Do not try to jump: they are high.
puerto.lesson.4.title: The safe
puerto.lesson.4: The key to the cell is in the office safe. With the stethoscope, turn the dial and listen: a click means the number is right. Three numbers.
puerto.lesson.5.title: The run
puerto.lesson.5: When the cell opens, the alarm goes off. Two and a half minutes to the boat at the Muelle de Heredia, with El Maestro.
puerto.q.2: What blinds the cameras for a while?
puerto.q.3: How do you cross the lasers?
puerto.q.3.a2: As fast as you can, any time
puerto.q.4: What do you need to open the safe?
puerto.safe.title: The office safe
puerto.safe.how: Turn the dial and listen through the stethoscope. Set the number when you hear the click.
puerto.safe.open: The handle turns: the safe is open!
puerto.safe.wrong: The handle does not move. Start again.
puerto.end.title: Season 3: the end
puerto.end.text: On the boat El Maestro looks back at the port. "Free again, and nobody hurt. Thank you, {alias}. The crew is whole."
puerto.end.guest: Sign in to receive El Maestro's thanks in coins.
puerto.end.items: New in the wardrobe: the captain's cap and the night-vision goggles.
